The ivory chalice belonged to Ludrek Prydenridge, head of the Prydenridge household. According to the custom, it passed to the eldest living child of the holder upon their death. The eldest child of Ludrek Prydenridge was his daughter, Havie Prydenridge. There is no information indicating that Ludrek Prydenridge has died or that the chalice has been passed on to another heir. Therefore, at the end of the record, Ludrek Prydenridge still holds the ivory chalice.

Answer: Ludrek Prydenridge.

Answer: Yera Stenworth.
